test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Chakma refugees are migrants to India from which of the following neighbouring countries?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Bangladesh**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chakma population is estimated to be around** 60,000.**
 
• Chakma, also called** Changma, Sakuma, or Sangma, the largest of the populations of Bangladesh, also settled in a passage between northeastern India and Myanmar (Burma). **
 
• Chakma language is an Indo- Aryan language spoken by the Chakma and Daingnet people.
 
• The language has common features with other languages in the region like the **Chittagonian, Tanchangya, Arakanese, and, others. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Chakma history says that they migrated to Arakan from the ancient area of Magadha in the present Bihar state of India. 
 
• The Chakma and the Hajong were settled in Arunachal Pradesh between** 1964- 69 **by the Indian government.
 
• The original population was around five thousand, but at present, it's said to be close to one lakh. 
 
• Chakmas practice Theravada Buddhism pigmented with aspects of animism and Hinduism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
